title: Bakery-Style Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
originalTitle: Bakery-Style Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (225g / 2 sticks) unsalted butter, browned in a pan and cooled slightly
1 large whole egg + 1 egg yolk (room temperature)
1 tsp baking soda & 3/4 tsp kosher salt
200g (7 oz) dark chocolate bar (60–70%), hand-chopped into puddles and shards
Flaky Maldon sea salt for finishing
instructions: Melt the butter over medium heat, swirling until the milk solids toast to a nutty hazelnut brown; pour into a mixing bowl and cool for 10 minutes.
Whisk the brown sugar and white sugar into the warm brown butter, then whisk in the whole egg, egg yolk, and vanilla extract until pale and ribbony.
Fold in the flour, baking soda, and kosher salt just until combined, then fold in the hand-chopped dark chocolate chunks.

Scoop into large 3-oz dough balls, chill for at least 30 minutes (or overnight), and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 11–12 minutes until golden around the edges and gooey in the center. Top with flaky sea salt.
